item.title: From dawn to dusk: why Hong Kong’s early sunsets beat the winter solstice
item.description:
Hong Kong’s evenings are drawing in, with darkness falling by about 5.40pm as the city enters its earliest sunset period of the year. The Hong Kong Observatory said on Wednesday that the stretch began on November 24, with sunsets of 5.38pm or earlier continuing until December 2. Although the winter solstice falls on December 22, Hong Kong’s earliest sunsets usually occur in late November, while its latest sunrises do not arrive until mid-January, it said.
